findings.defect: The subject is reversed. 노부 is Jeok Cheongang’s formal self-reference, not the unidentified Divine Physician.
findings.rationale: The line is part of Jeok Cheongang’s comically existential reaction: where was he, who was he, and why were boulders falling on him.

findings.current: He had no idea what was happening, but he had to get his body out of there first.
findings.defect: “Get his body out” is an unnatural calque that can sound as though he is moving a separate body.
findings.rationale: 몸부터 피하다 means to remove oneself from danger before doing anything else.
findings.replacement: He had no idea what was happening, but first he had to get himself to safety.
findings.source: 당최 상황이 어찌 되어 가는지는 모르나 우선은 몸부터 피하고 봐야 했다.

findings.current: Strength entered the hands holding the two people.
findings.defect: The sentence mechanically calques 힘이 들어가다 and is unnatural in English.
findings.rationale: The source describes Jeok Cheongang tightening his hold on Jin Taekyung and the Divine Physician.
findings.replacement: His grip tightened on the two men.
findings.source: 두 사람을 잡은 손에 힘이 들어간다.

findings.current: Within a short span of time that felt like an eternity, Jeok Cheongang finally took the last step toward the entrance of the prison.
findings.defect: The draft says he completed the final step, but the source says the collapse began just as he was about to take it.
findings.rationale: 떼려던 그때 marks an interrupted, not completed, action; that timing is what leaves the entrance blocked by the collapse.
findings.replacement: Within a short span of time that felt like an eternity, Jeok Cheongang was finally about to take the last step toward the prison entrance.
findings.source: 짧지만 억겁과도 같은 시간 속, 마침내 적천강이 뇌옥의 입구를 향해 마지막 한 걸음을 떼려던 그때였다.

findings.current: The order he was about to give was no different from ordering them to commit suicide.
findings.defect: The draft narrows the suicidal risk to his subordinates, although the deputy captain intends to lead them personally.
findings.rationale: The source leaves the doomed action collective and immediately establishes that the deputy captain will go first; it does not describe him merely sending others to die.
findings.replacement: The order he was about to give was tantamount to suicide.
findings.source: 지금부터 그가 내릴 명령은 자결이나 다름없었다.

findings.current: I see. Dark Heaven. I knew they’d be a bunch of son-of-a-bitches.
findings.defect: The draft turns Jeok Cheongang’s recognition of the attackers as Dark Heaven into a generic insult about what Dark Heaven members are like.
findings.rationale: 그 새끼들일 줄 알았지 means he suspected the hostile group would turn out to be those Dark Heaven bastards.
findings.replacement: I see. Dark Heaven. I knew it was those sons of bitches.
findings.source: 그렇군. 암천, 그 썅노무 새끼들일 줄 알았지.

findings.current: It was merely a minor skill I learned because I could not refuse my Master’s urging. What I devoted myself to was medicine.
findings.defect: “Could not refuse my Master’s urging” formalizes and softens 성화에 못 이겨, which means he was worn down by persistent pestering; the second sentence is also stiff.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the Divine Physician’s restrained tone while retaining the mildly humorous characterization of his Master’s persistence.
findings.replacement: It was only a little training I picked up because my Master pestered me into it. Medicine was where my heart lay.
findings.source: 스승님의 성화에 못 이겨 익힌 작은 공부일 뿐. 제가 뜻을 둔 것은 의술이었습니다.

findings.current: Why did it suddenly remind Jeok Cheongang of a physician who had reached the realm of the Divine Physician?
findings.defect: The draft makes “Divine Physician” a formal realm a physician can reach, rather than describing medical skill that has attained divine heights.
findings.rationale: 신의 경지 modifies the physician’s mastery of medicine; it is not the name of a cultivation realm or professional rank.
findings.replacement: Why did Jeok Cheongang suddenly think of a physician whose medical arts were said to have reached divine heights?
findings.source: 문득 의술이 신의 경지에 다다랐다는 한 의원이 생각나는 것은 왜일까.

findings.current: Can you still put your muscles to work?
findings.defect: The wording is an unnatural English rendering of a blunt question about physical strength.
findings.rationale: Jeok Cheongang is asking whether the Divine Physician is physically capable of carrying Jin Taekyung, setting up the carpenter response.

findings.current: Take care of Taekyung. Take care of that boy.
findings.defect: The draft duplicates a single heartfelt request as two separate commands.
findings.rationale: 태경이, 저 아이 identifies Taekyung as “that boy” within one request, while 부탁하네 entrusts him to the Divine Physician.
findings.replacement: I’m leaving Taekyung in your care.

findings.current: Above the sky, amid the dark clouds that had receded, a boy stood tall in the sunlight.
findings.defect: “Above the sky” is physically incoherent, and “amid the dark clouds that had receded” obscures that sunlight is streaming through the opening clouds.
findings.rationale: 저 하늘 위 places the boy high in the sky, while 먹구름 사이로 비추는 햇살 describes sunlight shining between the clouds.
findings.replacement: High in the sky, a boy stood bathed in sunlight streaming through a break in the retreating dark clouds.
findings.source: 저 하늘 위, 어느새 물러간 먹구름 사이로 비추는 햇살을 받으며 한 소년이 우뚝 서 있었다.

findings.current: The boy’s eyes were clear and sparkling like a child’s, yet they held the cunning, seasoned gaze of someone who felt no emotion whatsoever.
findings.defect: “Cunning” adds deceit absent from 노회한, while “someone who felt no emotion” changes an unreadable gaze into an assertion that the person is incapable of feeling emotion.
findings.rationale: The source contrasts youthful-looking eyes with an aged, experienced gaze from which Jeok Cheongang can discern no emotion.
findings.replacement: Those eyes were clear and bright like a boy’s, yet the gaze itself was ancient and seasoned, betraying no emotion whatsoever.
findings.source: 소년의 그것처럼 맑고 반짝이는 듯하면서도, 아무런 감정도 느껴지지 않는 노회한 눈빛.

summary: Two critical subject/action errors, one major change to who faces a suicidal order, one major characterization shift, and several localized register and natural-English issues.
